text: The purpose of this report is to amend the City's records retention by-law to establish the process to deem digitized copies as original records and enable the disposition of source physical records.

City Council on July 19 and 20, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend Municipal Code Chapter 217, Records, Corporate, by establishing amendments to the body of the Chapter as set out in Attachment 1 to the report (June 22, 2023) from the City Clerk.
